methodologyNotes: Products were selected from the specified roster of high-search immersion (hand/stick) blenders currently sold in the US market; countertop blenders were excluded. Specifications were re-verified against official brand pages (breville.com, vitamix.com, bamix.us, zwilling.com, all-clad.com, hamiltonbeach.com, muellerliving.com, braunhousehold.com, cuisinart.com, kitchenaid.com), major retailer pages (Target, Home Depot, HomeOutletDirect, Best Buy, Amazon), and third-party reviews (Foodal). priceUsd reflects published US MSRP/regular (non-sale) price confirmed across multiple retail sources; where the brand-stated MSRP and prevailing street price differ, the published regular price is used and the street price is noted in priceNote/provenance. booleans are true for yes and false for no; speed_settings records the number of discrete preset speeds (or "variable" as a string when only continuous/pressure-based control is offered); power_watts is the rated motor wattage as a number. accessedAt 2026-06-19. Adversarial fact-check pass: fixed one dead source URL (Cuisinart), reconciled Braun MQ9137XI list-vs-street price, and confirmed all 13 products exist with no fabricated models.
